name: 正解と意味の案内
prompt:

Edit Image1 (LH05-0004-v001), change only the incorrect font weights and success badge color.
Reference hierarchy: Image2 ORIGINAL source controls check glyph shape, proportions, optical weight and fine details. Image3 existing Japanese mock is secondary for typography roles and content. Keep original controls as authority, never reproduce malformed substitute glyphs.
Keep the heading “正解です！” Meiryo Bold20/28. Change “意味” to Meiryo REGULAR12/16, no bold. Change button label “次へ進む” to Meiryo REGULAR14/24, no bold; its strokes must be the same ordinary weight as body “パン屋さんへ行きます。” and “パンを二つ買いませんか？”. Preserve those two body lines verbatim and Regular14/24, zero tracking.
Change the circular success badge from bright lime/leaf green to solid FOREST #1F6444. Preserve its exact original-style white check geometry and current circle size.
Keep pure-white canvas, white card, subtle neutral outline/shadow, forest gradient primary button #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, exact existing layout, corner shapes, Japanese wording, line breaks and spacing. Do not add or remove anything. No new decoration, extra text, artwork or controls. Return one compact corrected component.
reviewNotes: Correction inspected: badge now forest green and original circular check anatomy retained. Japanese lines, white panel and gradient CTA correct. Metadata and button still appear heavier than locked Regular roles; exact typography unresolved after bounded correction. Preserve v1 andv2; needs-correction. No owner approval/editability/runtime claim.
